videos.uso: Inicio · Impermeabilización: video junto a la lista de capas, sobre fondo verde oscuro. En teléfono va arriba, a ancho completo.
videos.imagen: Photorealistic technical 3D cutaway of a section of a flat building roof shown as an exploded view: four thick square layers floating one above the other with clear gaps between them. Bottom: gray concrete slab with visible aggregate texture. Second: black bituminous sealant layer with glossy seams. Third: green waterproof membrane sheet with overlapping welded seams. Top: light gray-green protective coating with fine granules. Light rain drops falling onto the top layer and beading on its surface. Three-quarter isometric camera angle, the stack centered in the frame with generous space around it, deep dark green studio background (#14281A) with soft green rim light, premium product-visualization look. No text, no labels, no numbers, no logos, no people.
videos.movimiento: Slow, smooth cinematic camera orbit around the exploded roof layers. The four layers gently float and slowly settle closer together. Rain drops keep falling onto the top layer, bead up and roll off its edges; no water passes through the membrane. Calm, steady, seamless motion suitable for a looping website background. Keep the stack centered. No text, no people, no sudden cuts.
